description: Verify that the front panel section (e.g., lines 1-10 or a specific header block) remains byte-for-byte identical to the original artifact.
Ensure that the specific legal copy defect (e.g., incorrect jurisdiction, missing disclaimer, or typo in legal term) is corrected in the body text.
Confirm that no new lines have been added or removed outside the specific legal copy section, preserving overall file structure.
command: wc -l back.md && diff <(tail -n +11 back.md) <(tail -n +11 original_back.md) | grep -v "^>\|^<"
